verdict.rationale:
Ramp documents explicit background-automation capabilities: agents.ramp.com describes 'Long-running access — for background agents that run on a schedule' with per-agent keys, human sponsors, auto-approve policies, and full attribution; webhooks enable event-driven automations; specific autonomous flows are documented (hotel rebooking on price drops, auto top-up with target balances, auto-coding/fraud/approval agents running 'around the clock'). Live probes confirm the MCP server and OpenAPI/CLI surfaces actually exist and are OAuth-gated with granular write scopes, corroborating these aren't just vendor claims on paper.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (outside vendor docs) that a scheduled/background agent workflow was actually run end-to-end without human intervention; community evidence is generic product sentiment, not specific to autonomous automation.
